name: Giyim 030 — varyantlı ürünler görünür
description: Demo Giyim (030) firmasında ürün listesinde TSHIRT-VAR / PHONE-VAR veya varyantlı giyim ürünleri görünür.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Giyim (CODE 030), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open Management / Yönetim and go to the products / ürünler list
Verify the product list shows at least one variant product such as TSHIRT-VAR or PHONE-VAR, or a product row clearly marked as having size/color variants
